artifact_summary: Implementation summary for Stop hook TTS fix: cooldown in tts-notify.sh, TTS call in claude-stop-notify.sh, and idle_prompt in settings.json Notification matcher

completion_data.completion_summary: Added 10-second cooldown dedup to tts-notify.sh (shared /tmp/claude-tts-last-notify), inserted tts-notify.sh call in the claude-stop-notify.sh non-workflow-active branch for audible Stop notifications, and added idle_prompt to the Notification hook matcher in settings.json.

memory_candidates.content: When adding new callers to tts-notify.sh, the shared cooldown file /tmp/claude-tts-last-notify deduplicates TTS announcements within 10 seconds across all callers (Stop hook, lifecycle path, Notification hook). Set TTS_COOLDOWN=0 to bypass cooldown for testing.
